Distributed Control System7. PLC Network8. PLC Selection9. Monitor Control System10. Laboratory work: 5~7 experiments

description.zh: 簡介，感測器，基本驅動器，順序及計時控制，PLC，伺服驅動器及放大器，基本伺服控制系統。
description.en: Course Title:Mechatronics PracticeDescription:To familiarize students with the usage of mechatronictechniques and corresponding parts/components

description.zh: 各種時域響應之電腦繪圖，矩陣各項特性分析與應用，根值軌跡圖，波德圖，奈奎士圖，PID控制器之設計，Lead-Lag補償器之設計，控制器時域及頻域分析，控制器在狀態空間之設計，實例探討，書報研讀。
description.en: Course Title:Automatic Control PracticeDescription:This course is first to introduce the basic concepts ofcontrol systems and the mathematical background, second, state thetransfer function, block diagram and signal flow graph, third,discuss the mathematical modeling of control systems and elements, andforth, describe the time-domain analysis, root locus techniques andfrequency-domain of control systems, and then to measure the characterof control systems, Finally, the design of control system will beintroduced.

description.zh: 最佳化組合邏輯之演算法，可規劃邏輯元件，組合邏輯之VLSI設計，使用MSI與標準電路元件設計多層邏輯，使用閘陣列設計，循序邏輯之元件，循序邏輯之分析與合成，VLSI之設計與測試技巧，各種CALD軟體工具介紹。
description.en: 1.Algorithms for Optimization of combirational logic2.VLSI realizations of combination logic3.Multilevel logic using complex parts and cells.4.Components of sequential systems5.Synthesis of clock-mode sequential circuits.

description.zh: 先修課程:負責教授同意．煞車動力學，煞車性能之極限，液壓煞車系統及元件，鼓式煞車，碟式煞車，駐車煞車，真空輔助動力煞車，液壓輔助動力煞車，電動輔助動力煞車，防鎖死煞車系統．
description.en: Brake Dynamics, LImit of Braking Performance, Hydraulic-Brake-System Components, Drum Brake, Disc Brake, Parking Brake, Vacuum-Assist Power Brake, Hydraulic-Assist Power Brake, Electro-Hydraulic-Assist Power Brake, Antilock Brakes System。

description.zh: 本課程將介紹各種冷凍空調領域相關之熱傳介質，以及其物理和化學性質，進而瞭解各種熱傳介質在工程系統上的實際應用。涵蓋對象包括相關各相關流體，如冷媒、鹵水、氣體等，和元件材料及絕緣材料。針對其熱力上的特性深入說明。如熱傳係數、黏滯度、熱焓、比熱等，並教授各物理性質之推算方式，可靠度等，以彌補文獻上相關熱傳介質之物性化性不足之缺憾，提供工程設計時所需之準確估算，配合各種不同形式之熱交換器設計上之相關問題，將進一步導入有效節能技術，以期建立一系列工程系統設計時熱傳介質之應用及掌握的準則。
description.en: This course introduces some heat transfer media concerning about refrigeration and air-conditioning technology. The chemical and physical properties of these media and their practical applications are also presented. The heat transfer media covered are important fluids such as refrigerants, brine and gases etc, and materials of system compoments and insulations. The estimation methods of their physical properties such as conductivity, viscosity, specific heat, diffusion coefficients are focused and verified to compensate the shortage of known data. The design of different types of heat exchanger are then performed to emphasize the importance of property- estimation.

description.zh: 各種冷煤壓縮機簡介，容積式壓縮機效率分析，離心式壓縮機分析，各種送風機簡介，送風機應用，泵之應用分析。
description.en: Introduction to refrigerant compressors, efficiency analysis of volumetric compressors, analysis of centrifugal compressors, introduction to fans, applications of fans, and application of pumps.

description.zh: 介紹各種精密化學分析儀器之原理及應用﹐學習組成結構之 鑑定、物種之分離及分析之工作方法。
description.en: Instruments are the tools for gathering qualitative and quantitative information about the composition and structure of matter, students must develop an understanding of these tools and how they are used to solve analytical problems.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在(一)使學生瞭解重要化學品之合成原理與工業上的合成程序；(二)使學生瞭解合成反應與反應機購及工業合成程序的應用。內容包括基本合成原理，有機合成反應，無機合成反應，重要化學品之合成與利用。
description.en: Studies of syntheric principles of chemical and synthetic processes of industry. Chenmical reaction of synthesis, mechanism of chemical reaction, application of processes of industrial synthesis also included.

description.zh: 本課程的目標在使學生了解工業安全衛生的重要,熟悉有關知識及緊急措施,從而增加處變之因應能力.內容包括工業安全衛生組織,事故調查分析,工廠設備安全要領,工業衛生和衛生設備.
description.en: TThis course is design to introduce the student to concept of the importance of industrial safety and health with emphasis on the ability of dealing with accidents. Topics covered are organization of industrial safety , analysis of Accident ,industrial health and facilities.

description.zh: 本課程綜合的介紹電化學之原理與其應用.在原理方面包括離子之作用及其平衡,電解質之導電性質,界面現象,電極電位,電化學電池和電極動力程序等內容.而在應用方面則涵蓋溶液物理參數測量,電化學分析技術,電化學感應器,電鍍,表面處理,金屬腐蝕防治,電池,電透析和電合成等
description.en: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to principles of electrochemistry and its applications. In the principles which includes ionic interaction, ionic equilibrium, the conducting properties of electrolytes, interfacial phenomena, electrode potentials, electrochemical cells and electrode kinetic process. For the application covers determination of physical parameters in the solutions, electroanalytical techniques, electroplating, electrochemical sensors, surface finishing, metal corrosion prevention, cells, electrodialysis, and electrosynthesis etc.

description.zh: 本課程強調表面化學性質之基本原理及其應用。內容可分成三部份：（一）液體之表面張力、熱力學及有關表面電力方面之性質，潤溼、清潔、乳化及起泡。（二）固體表面化學強調固體表面之生成及鑑定，固液間之接觸角、吸附及溶液表面分子的黏著現象。（三）介紹固氣界面，氣體及蒸汽在固體表面上之吸附，化學吸附及催化。
description.en: The course describes the foundamental principles and the application of Surface Chemistry, which is concentrated in following three major fields:(1) The surface tension, thermodynamics of the liquids and their related electrical properties, wetting, cleaning, emulsification and foaforming.(2) The surface chemistry of solid state emphasizes the formation of a solid surface, its characterzation, the liquid-solid contact angle, the adsorption, and the adhesion phenomena on molecular basis.(3) The interfacial phenomena at the solid-gas interface, the adsorption of gas or vapor on the solid surface, the chemistry of adsorption and the catalysis.

description.zh: 本課程介紹目前各種材料的結構.性質及功能,並且就各種工程材料如金屬.高分子.陶瓷材料的製程加以討論.1. 材料科學及工程緒論.2. 原子結構及鍵結.3. 結晶構造及晶體幾何學.4. 凝固程序及結晶缺陷.5. 材料之機械性質.6. 金屬材料.7. 高分子材料.8. 陶瓷材料.9. 腐蝕.
description.en: This course is designated to acquaint the student with the strictures, properties and performances of materials. It contains the following topics:1. introduction to materials sciences and engineering.2. atomic structures and bonding.3. crystal structures and crystal geometry.4. solidification and crystalline imperfections.5. mechanical properties of materials.6. metals.7. polymers.8. ceramics.9. corrosion.

description.zh: 介紹工業觸媒在化學工業上所扮演的重要角色與有關吸附與催化之理論基礎，使學生瞭解工業觸媒的各種型態、物性、化性、鑑定方法、基本製造方法、性能評估及動力測試等內容在工業上實際應用例包括氫化、氧化、烷基化、裂解、重組、分餾、脫硫工程、汽車廢氣之控制以及藥物之合成。
description.en: Studies of homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysis, with emphasis on industrial applications. Catalytic processes, engineering problems, catalysts preparation, deactivation and regeneration also discussed.

description.zh: 電鍍工程是特別設計之金屬,塑膠與陶瓷等表面處理之濕鍍工程技術課程,其內容包括基礎電化學,鍍件之前處理與後處理.一般之單元金屬電鍍,合金電鍍,複合電鍍,鋁陽極處理,金屬,塑膠與陶瓷上之化學鍍.電鍍工程,環保廢水處理及公害防止,程序管理與品質控制,哈路槽試驗,添加物與光澤劑等.
description.en: Electroplating engineering is a course of specially designed wet processes for surface finishing of metals, plastics and ceramics substrate. It consist of basic electrochemistry, pretreatment and after treatment for plating, commercial plating. Anodizing of aluminum, chemical plating on metals, plastics and ceramics, plating engineering, environmental waste treatment, process and quality control, Hull cell testing, additives and brightened

description.zh: 1.晶體結構與晶體生長 2.載體濃度與能階圖 3.載體傳輸,擴散,漂移4.半導體的光電特性 5.pn接面分析
description.en: 1.crystal structures & crystal growth 2.energy-band diagrams & carrier densities 3.carrier transport 4.optoelectronic properties of semiconductors 5.pn junctions

description.zh: 本課程主要是講述由粉末冶金技術製造的材料與產品包括：高熔點材料、超硬質材料、超耐熱材料、燒結電接點材料、燒結機械另件燒結摩擦材料、燒結磁性材料等，以期讓學過粉末冶金課程的學生，能進一步對粉末冶金技術之應用有更多的了解。
description.en: The course mainly lecture the materials and products which are made by powdermetallurgy techniques, including high melting material, super hard material, superheat resistant material, sintered electricjoint material, sintered mechanical parts, sintered friction material, sintered magnetic material, etc., it is expected students wholearn the powder metallurgy course may have further understanding to theapplication of powder metallurgy techniques.

description.zh: 紡織纖維、高功能性與高機能性纖維可被運用在很多的終端用途上，尤勝於消費性衣著與家飾用紡織品。本課程被設計為介紹有關纖維製品在汽車領域、建築用織物結構、布篷與戶外飾布、紡織複合材料、輸送皮帶、過濾、土工布等之應用、適用於危險工作的產品、適用於海運之產品、適用於太陽能、適用於航太空、輪胎及其他之終端用途上。
description.en: Textile fibers, high performance and high functional fibers are used in a variety of end applications other than consumer apparel and home furnishing products. The course is designed to introduce modern applications in automotive trim, architectural fabric structure, awnings/ outdoor furniture, textile composites,conveyor belt, filtration, geotextile and geogrid applilcation, and hazardous occupational products, marine products, aerospace, military products, passive solar systems, tire, etc.

description.zh: 從基本的生醫紡織品，如︰縫合線，人工血管，人工腎臟到人造肌膚等，說明其組成，製程，功能以及對生體的作用，另外人體對生醫材料之包容性，分解性，致癌性，毒性等詳細說明和比較。
description.en: Biomedical Textiles, is an introductory course designed for biomaterial compositions, manufacture, functionality and implantability. Biomaterials included in the course are sutures, vascular grafts, artificial organs, artificial tissues,etc. In addition, biocompatibility, biodegradability, carcinogenicity and toxicity of biomaterials are presented and compared in detail.

description.zh: 主要闡釋現代紡織工廠之整體設計理念；其課程內容包括選擇設廠地區之評估要素及其優劣點，規劃紡織工廠廠房之型式，設計紡織工廠之步驟，選定工廠之物料流程，計算及設計紡織各製程所需要設備數，排列紡織工廠之機械流程圖。並講述紡織工廠之溫度、溼度之重要性及標準範圍，配置動力設備、照明設備及空調設備。最後講述如何選擇最新科技化、自動化之紡織機械設備。
description.en: Design of textile factoryThe function of this class is mainly to explain the general design concept of modern textile factory, the class the ideas of selecting the evaluated elements of factory location as well as the advantages and disadvantages,to plan the workshop type of factory,organize the design step of the textile factory, to choosing the material flow of factory,estimating and instructing the amount of demanded equipment for all texile processes,and to lay out the machines flow chart for texile factory. In addition, the importance and standard range of temperature and moisture,the installation pf dynamics,illumination and air condition are explained.In the end ,there is a description of how to select the most nowadays technolngical and automatic texile mechanical equipment,

description.zh: 1.發展歷史與演進2.程序觀念3.非同步平行程序4.死結及無限等待5.主記憶體管理6.虛擬記憶體結構與管理7.處理器排程8.磁碟管理9.網路及系統安全
description.en: 1.History and evolution2.Process concepts3.ASynchronous concurrent processes4.Desdlock and indefinite postponrmrnt5.Real storage management6.Virtual storage organization and management7.Processor scheduling8.Disk mansgement9.Network and security

description.zh: 1.集合,序列與函數2.基礎邏輯3.關聯式4.計數（排列,組合）5.圖與樹（基礎圖論）6.遞迴式與演算法7.有向圖
description.en: 1.Sets Sequences and Function2.Elementary Logic3.Relations4.Counting5.Graph and Tree6.Recursion Trees and Algorithms7.Digraphs

description.zh: 課程內容包括以環境心理課題作為規劃之基本知識、人的感官與認知系統、環境營造對人類行為的影響、以及體驗效果的調查分析方法。
description.en: This course is directed toward an approved environment design project with research and design completed under supervision of the director. Theory and practice in research and development dealing with the design project is reviewed in the study. Projects must represent a meaningful contribution to the field of design base on supportive research.

description.zh: 讓學生習得參數式3D 電腦軟體與快速原型(RP)之應用技能，以利於提昇工業設計的效率與產能。
description.en: The study of integration of parametric 3D computer software and rapid prototyping (RP), in order to raise the efficiency and production of industrial design.

description.zh: 本課程將透過每週專題演講方式，讓學生了解有機材料之最新開發成品或最先進之研究成果。演講者之安排將以校外知名專家學者及校內各計畫執行者為主。
description.en: This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application on the organic materials. Speakers being invited are well-known scholars in organic area. Graduate students or thesis advisors will also be invited to report any in interesting result from their graduate studies.

description.zh: 土壤沖蝕(2),小集水區求Q,模型理論,輸砂理論,防洪工程,防砂工程,排水工程,土石流(2),防災技術(工法),專題討論.
description.en: Introduction,Soil erosion,Rational formula,Sediment transport,Flood control,Drainage engineering,Debris flow,Techniques of disaster prevention,Seminar

name.en: Soil and Water Disaster Prevention Techniques

description.zh: 自動化機械設計、驅動器及感測器、自動化機構合成及應用、數位電路設計及應用、氣液壓及電控回路之邏輯設計、監控系統、自動化系統之規化及評估。
description.en: Automated Machinery Design, Actuators and sensors, Automatic mechanism synthesis and applications, Logic design of pneumatic, Hydraulic and electronic control loop, Monitor and control system, automation system, Planning evaluation.

description.zh: 簡介及概論、視窗作業系統及應用界面(API)，DDL、DDE及OLE基本程式設計，Client應用程式及Server應用程式架構，多媒體，影像壓縮及運動，圖形監控系統等。
description.en: Introduction, Window operation System, API, DDL, Design of DDE and OLE, Structure of Client/Server System, Multimedia, Image Compression, Graphic supervisory/control system.

description.zh: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論
description.en: Case Study. Seminar. Group meeting.

description.zh: 本課程介紹如何應用數值分析理論求解工程問題。包含數值方法基本觀念，數值方法之誤差及穩定性，非線性代數方程式之數值解法，聯立代數方程式之數值解法，矩陣特徵值求法，非線性聯立方程式之數值解法，多項式插值法及曲線嵌合，數值微分與積分，常微分方程式及偏微分方程式之數值解法 。
description.en: Introduction of using numerical methods to solve practical engineering problems. Topics include Solving nonlinear equations, Solving sets of equations, interpolation and curve fitting, numerical differentiation and integration, numerical solution of ODE and PDE.

description.zh: 先修課程︰流體力學、熱力學本課程主要針對建築物防火及排煙技術作深入探討，主要闡述︰1. 火災動力學2. 防火材料性質3. 排煙技術4. 防火排煙設備5. 防火材料及設備測試6. 建築物防火排煙設計
description.en: The main objective of this course is to offer a postgraduate level of the knowledge of fire safety and smoke control technology for buildings.The course includes the following topics:1. The outline of the dynamics of a fire2. The property of fire safety materials3. The smoke dynamics and smoke control technology4. The facilities for fire safety and smoke control.5. Testing of materials and facilities for fire safety and smoke control.6. Design of a fire safety and smoke control system for a building.

name.en: Fire Safety and Smoke Control Technology

description.zh: 從闡述各種汽車共生系統在特定的工業製程，商業智慧型大樓或大學校園區域網路型式等能源有效利用的整合規劃設計，主要課程內容為： 1.汽車共生系統概念 2.熱力循環的技術理論 3.多元化的原動機利用 4.複合循環發電廠 5.都會型汽電共生利用 6.汽電共生的能源管理 7.汽電共生的環境管理 8.各種熱電轉換裝置 9.高級能源轉換科技之汽電共生
description.en: By studying this course, the following terms can be identified, defined, used: 1.The Concept of Cogeneration system 2.Theory of Cogeneration Technology. 3.Combined cycles plant. 4.Heating and cooling integration with power generation. 5.The Design Concept and Demonstrated economic performance of cogen. sys. 6.Social and Environmental management of cogen. sys. 7.Conversion Method and Technology on advanced system.

description.zh: 由於台灣地小人稠,為了更有效利用土地,達到更高之生產量,使得土壤污染問題特別顯得重要,因此整治土壤污染是刻不容緩.本課程對於土壤污染之整治由萃取,氣提,固定安定化,淋洗,電熔等物化方法傳授之,其次講授生物復育技術,最後以工程經濟角度,進行本益比分析。.
description.en: There are many remediate methods in this class.The methods include solvent extraction,air stripping,solidification/stabilization,solid flushing,and thermel treatment.This f topicalso includes bioremediation and cost effective analysis.

description.zh: 企業經營體制個案診斷，以診斷方式、技術、步驟及書面、口頭報告應如何撰寫。
description.en: This topic focus on the case study which based on diagnostic method, technique, skill, procedure, and reporting and presenting skill..

description.zh: 本課程授課主要內容分為三部分：第一部份為都市防災概論，此部分主要針對國內外文獻作一回顧，進而瞭解都市防災整體架構，區分為（1）文獻回顧；（2）防災基本計畫；及（3）防災整體架構等。期使國內都市計畫能逐步邁向防災都市計畫，以建立『安全都市』為目標。此部分的主要內容區分為：（1）都市災害風險理念的形成；（2）防災都市計畫與地區防災系統規劃；（3）都市計畫防災系統規劃原則；（4）都市計畫防災作業準則內容架構；（5）都市計畫防災作業準則；（6）安心都市計畫的形成與實現。第三部分為實務操作部分，以草屯鎮為例，藉九二一大地震的實例，深入探討災情調查的方法，實際調查狀況及研訂災後重建的程序與計畫內容，期望成為國內都市重建計畫的範例，主要內容區分為：（1）緒論；（2）重建理論；（3）草屯鎮現況發展；（4）災情調查方法與重建程序之建立；（5）災情調查分析與重建計畫內容研訂等。
description.en: The subject will be presented in three partsPart One - (1) Literature retrospection; (2) Fundamental planning for disaster prevention; (3) An integrated disaster prevention organization.Part Two -The major contents to be addressed include (1) Formation of urban disaster cataclysm and risk; (2) Urban disaster prevention plan and regional disaster protection system planning; (3) Principles for planning disaster prevention system in urban plan; (4) Operational standards and organization for urban disaster prevention; (5) Operational guidelines for urban disaster prevention; (6) Realization and formation of trouble free urban plan.Party Three -. The major contents are (1) Introduction; (2) rehabilitation theory; (3) Current development in Tsaotun City; (4) Establishment of damage survey method and rehabilitation procedures; (5) Detail analysis of damage survey report and preparation of rehabilitation plan content.

description.zh: 本課程為探討與建築批評有關的理論、方法，及評論寫作技巧等，以研討及演練的方式進行。課程共分三部份：1.批評理論的研討。2.中、外建築評論作品研讀、討論。3.評論寫作演練。
description.en: This course explores the theories, methods and writing skills in relation to architectural critique. The course is undertaken by ways of seminar and practicing. It consists of three parts as below.1. Studying on critique theories.2. Reading and discussing articles of architectural critique.3. Practicing the critique writings.

description.zh: 先修課程：3001018或負責教授同意。此課程為製造組基本重要課程、其內容為討論定形刀刃和非定形刀刃之切削機構、塊狀和板金之變形機構、以及連結和剝離機構。並討論上述之各種加工實例。例如車、銑、鑽、磨、搪拋光、焊接、EDM、ECM、USM、LBM、EBM、鍛造及沖壓等加工情形。
description.en: Introduction to Manufacturing Systems, Theories of Metal Processing including Electrical Methods, Case Studies of Manufacturing Systems, Discuss of the Metal Processing of Manufacture.

description.zh: 先修課程：3001018或負責教授同意。此課程為製造組基本重要課程、其內容為討論定形刀刃和非定形刀刃之切削機構、塊狀和板金之變形機構、以及連結和剝離機構。並討論上述之各種加工實例。例如車、銑、鑽、磨、搪拋光、焊接、EDM、ECM、USM、LBM、EBM、鍛造及沖壓等加工情形。
description.en: Introduction to Manufacturing Systems, Theories of Metal Processing including Electrical Methods, Case Studies of Manufacturing Systems, Discuss of the Metal Processing of Manufacture.

description.zh: 在產品設計的規則中,如何事先考慮材料的使用,加工生產的方法,資源回收等重要因素;以減低公害,環境污染及節省能源等問題為前提,以達有效的維護環境的完美設計.
description.en: The aim of this course is to study ways of implementation of sustainable relation between humans and the environment by designing products that are sustainable to ecology -- easy to recycle, energy saving, safe and accessible to people of all age and gender.

description.zh: 反應工程是在商業規模之考慮下對化學反應開發利用之相關工程活動。其目的在成功的設計和操作化學反應器，並使化學工程在工程專業中成為一個獨特的支系。此高等反應工程是延續大學部己學習在均相中有關之簡單觀念及理論，並推展到非均相較複雜系統之設計及操作上。學生在修習此課後，對於較複雜之反應器有清晰及整體之概念。
description.en: Under commercial scale consideration, chemical reaction engineering is that engineering concerning the exploitiaton of chemical reactions Its goal is the successful design and operation of chemical reactors and it sets chemical engineering apart as a distinct branch of the engineering profession. This aduanced chemical reaction engineering is a continuative study of simple idea and principle for homogeneous systems and extended to heterogeneous and more complex systems for design and operation. After study in this course, the student can obtain clear and unified coucept of complex reactor systems.

description.zh: 素描是一切繪畫基礎，設計產品，有美的意念，還要有能力將之畫出來，才算完成，否則即成空泛理論。(一)鉛筆練習：線條方向、明暗度變化、立體概念、光影效果等。(二)方形器物練習：以平移法正確掌握立方體造形，並將明暗效果表現出來。(三)圓柱體練習：畫易開罐飲料罐，能繪出其質感效果和細部文字、圖樣。(四)圓形物練習：能把握造形、質感、量感、光澤，以水果為練習對象，如蘋果、橘子等。(五)多種形體練習：如松果、貝殼、落葉等，均能把握其造形、質感、光影特色。由完全沒有概念開始，訓練至有寫生能力，也學得耐心、細心和觀察力。
description.en: Sketch is the base of painting. The product design and concept of beauty must be expressed; otherwise, it will become only a talk.Contents:1.Pencil practicing: lining, chiaroscuro, cubism, lighting, etc.2.Square ware practicing: controlling the cubism styling with a horizontal movement, also, expressing chiaroscuro, etc.3.Cylinder practicing: drawing beverage can with the sense of its quality, detail, and picture.4.Round object practicing: styling, quality, quantity, luster; also, drawing fruit, such as, apple, orange, etc.5.Multiple-shape practicing: such as, pin cines, shell, falling leaves with the sense of styling, quality, lighting, etc.The course is to train students who have are inexperienced to sketch with the ability of patient, detailing, and observation.

description.zh: 從早期的原住民社會，到漢人移民社會的建立，乃至今日多元化的工商業社會，在不同的年代歌謠與大眾生活的關係密切。傳統社會中民間歌謠具有祈福、教化、娛樂等功能，為數甚巨的民間歌謠是理解庶民社會的重要途徑；而當今社會中流行歌謠雖是商業機制下的產品，但其映見了大眾的情感與價值觀，也記錄了社會變遷的軌跡。本課程主要以台灣的歌謠為文本，透過歌謠內容的爬梳整理，以歌謠為史料建構大眾的生活圖像，生動地呈現出台灣社會變遷的面向。 從早期的原住民社會，到漢人移民社會的建立，乃至今日多元化的工商業社會，在不同的年代歌謠與大眾生活的關係密切。傳統社會中民間歌謠具有祈福、教化、娛樂等功能，為數甚巨的民間歌謠是理解庶民社會的重要途徑；而當今社會中流行歌謠雖是商業機制下的產品，但其映見了大眾的情感與價值觀，也記錄了社會變遷的軌跡。本課程主要以台灣的歌謠為文本，透過歌謠內容的爬梳整理，以歌謠為史料建構大眾的生活圖像，生動地呈現出台灣社會變遷的面向。
description.en: From the early aboriginal society to the immigrant society of the Hans and even to the current society, songs--in different period of times--always play an important role in civil life. In traditional society, folksongs perform the functions of instruction, religion and entertainment. A large number of folksongs serve the gateway to understand the common people. Though today's pop-songs are the products of entertainment business, they still reflect common people's emotions and values as well as label the mark of social change. Taiwanese songs (including folksongs and pop-songs) are important texts in this course. Through the analysis of the song lyrics, the students are expected to draw a vivid picture of the social change in the past.

description.zh: 本課程的目標在培養學生具備有關健康的知識，以度過健康的一生。為達成此目標，本課程提供學生四方面內容。一、健康與人生概述，包括人生的意義，健康的境界，認識自己的身體；二、生理健康之道，包括健康的飲食門道，體重控制與運動處方，學習終身修練的功夫，用葯知識；三、心理健康之道，包括健康的人格發展，情緒管理，健康的人際關係，健康的性，健康的家庭生活，健康地面對老化與死亡；四、健康的生活環境，包括物理、化學與生物的環境，健康的職場生活，健康的休閒生活等。本課程除講授法外，並用影片、討論、個別習作等方式教學。
description.en: This subject is to cultivate the students to be full of health knowlodge and to lead them have healthy and happy lives, For getting this object this course offers the students with four arear of knowledge. First, the introduction:including meaning of life, significacne of health, know oneself's body. Second, the ways for getting physical health including food and types of nutrients, determining desirable weight, principles of exercise programs, learning a life-long Kun fu, medical use of drugs. Third, the ways for getting mental health:including good development of personality, management of emotion, good interpersoal relationship, healthful sexuality, happy family life, coming to terms with aging and death. Fourth, healthful environment:including physical, chemical and biological environment, professional, socia and leisured lives of suitability. For most effective learning, the metho of video,discuss and indivdual practice teaching are as well used as the lecture.

description.zh: 面對科技發展日新月異，社會急驟變遷的新世紀，只習得專業上的一技之長，已不足以和協圓滿地實踐有意義的人生。有鑑於此，乃以生涯發展與生涯諮商的理論與研究為基礎，配合學生的發展，希翼能透過教育的歷程，使學生的專業知識能和未來的工作與生活規劃，產生有意義的聯結，進而為學生提供一個短程與長程的生涯發展與選擇的準備與指引。授課內容包括生涯理念介紹、興趣、性格、價值觀探索，生涯決定因素，生涯技巧，生涯角色調適，生涯選擇與規劃技巧，生涯訪談，生涯高原調適，轉型期調適，性別、職業歧視，雙生涯家庭，就業準備等主要生涯課題的研討與習作。
description.en: In face of a new century with continuous scientific development and rapid social changes, to learn one single professional skill is not enough to fulfill a meaningful life in a harmonic and satisfactory manner. In view of this, based on the theory and research of career development and consultation in association with the development of students, it is hoped to produce a meaningful linking between their professional knowledge and job and life planning through the course of eucation, and further to provide them a preparation and guide for short and long-range career development and choice. The contents of the course include the discussion and exercise related to major career topics such as introduction to the concept of career, the discussion of interest, character and value, decisive factors of career, skills of career, role adjustment in career, career choice and planning skill, career interview, uphill adjustment in career, adjustment in transit period, sex and occupation.

description.zh: 人際關係是探討對自我的了解及對人的認知，包括性格、態度、魅力、溝通、壓力、挫折和情緒等重要課題的處理；幫助同學學習與各種不同品味、信念、立場與生活方式的人作有效率的溝通，開放的表達出自己的感覺與想法，以建立良好的合作關係，從而開發潛能、爭取更好的發展機會。
description.en: Interpersonal Relationship is to discuss about self-understanding and perception of other people, including how to handle key issues related to character, attitude, attractiveness, communication, pressure, frustration and emotion. It helps students to learn effective communication, open their minds to express personal feeling and thought, and try to communicate with other people having different tastes, convictions, standpoints and ways of living so as to establish a harmonic and cooperative relationship and furtherly to develop personal potential and strive for better opportunity of development.

description.zh: 法學概論，顧名思義是在介紹法律原理，以啟發學生法學研究的興趣。然而，法學涵蓋的層面甚廣，法學緒論的課程，只能大略介紹各種法律的共通原理，就繁駁的法律現象，作綜合的引說，俾使初學法律的人，不僅能粗知「實定法」的共通原則，還可藉此原則來培養法律見解和修養，執簡馭繁，因而體會法律的性質、內涵和理念。有關本課程的教授方式，擬先介紹法律的基概念及原理，並以答問之方式訓練學生邏輯反思的能力，同時輔以日常屢見之法律實例問題。如此，學生不僅可以可以學習正確的法律觀念和知識，並可培養縝密思辨的能力，將課堂上所習得的知識應用落實在日常生活中，以達保障並維護自己及他人權益之目的。
description.en: Introduction of Law is to introduce the theory of law and to promote students' interest to study law. Since the field of law is very broad but the time is limited, this course can briefly explain common principles of law, complex phenomena of law, etc. The main purpose of this course is to let students catch the concept of common principles of "lex scripta." Also, this course aims to promote students' knowledge about law, thus cultivating their spirit of abiding by law. This course will introduce the basic concept and theory of law first. Then students will be given logical training through discussion. Besides, the general cases and problems of law will be covered as well. Through this course, students can not only get correct concepts of law, but learn to protect their/others' right.

description.zh: 民主政治為法治政治，凡政府各項施政均需有法令依據。行政法，乃是國家各行政機關所適用之各種法令規章之總稱，其內容含蓋國家行政機關之組織、職權、作用、程序及爭訟等事項之法規，範圍至為廣泛，且與人民之權利、義務息息相關。本課程將以系統化、生動化，並輔以實例之方式講授，以啟發同學學習興趣。同學修習本課程，除可增進法治知能與素養外，並可對日常生活之權益維護有重大裨益。
description.en: Democracy is regarded as rule by law nowadays. All official policies that are implemented by government must be based on law. Administrative law is a general term of all kinds of regulations and laws that are suitable for administrative organizations. The content includes of administrative organization in this country. The course serves as extensive rules that are related to people is rights and obligations. The principle emphasis of the course is on the systematic instruction with specific examples tc enlighten students learning interest, furthermore not only promoting knowledge and professional training in law but also effective in daily life.

description.zh: 本課程之設計，係針對法商科系以外之學生，對一般法律的認知與瞭解，尤其對自身權益之維護更為重要。吾知在今日工商發達、社會經濟劇變的時代，無論個人或企業體，將法不惟關乎人與人間的財產或身份地位，抑且為發展權義之淵源。故在講授私法體系的概念與運用時，較偏重案例說明，使學生於日後經濟生活中有所裨益，(授課內容見附件授課大綱)。
description.en: This course is designed to impart basic understanding and knowledge of the law to students who are not business or law majors. In particular, students will be provided with a basic framework explaining the application of legal principles to their own lives, thus enabling them to pursue business interests and maintain legal rights. Areas of application include: in the modern business world, its application to both individuals and corporate entities, property claims and personal status. It defines not only rights but also duties and obligations. Case studies will be the primary material relied upon in class discussion, thus acquainting students with actual situations which they may someday encounter.

description.zh: 教學目標：針對當前社會中之政治、經濟、社會、文化等各層面所形成之重大問題與現象加以探討，予以概略整合性之介紹，以使學生對社會現況更加瞭解並進而關懷所生活之環境。開課基礎：以原開設之社會科學概論為基礎，而向實務面擴充之課程。教學內容：採單元教學、口授、作業、探討意見交換並行方式進行。1.真正的民意－政治生態與國會。2.尖銳的對立－政黨競爭。3.台灣經驗－經濟奇蹟。4.高齡化的社會－銀髮族與人生。5.應關懷的族群－社福。6.立國的基礎－教育改革。7.慾望街車－犯罪與司法。8.和平發展之關鍵－兩岸關係。9.其他。
description.en: Teaching goal: Analyze the significant problems and phenomena concerning politics, economy, society and culture, and give a brief account of such phenomena with a view to facilitating students' understanding of the status quo and encouraging students to devote care to their living environment. Pre-course requirement: A basic grasp of "the Introduction of Social Science" is required for more advanced and expanded discussions in this course are based on it.Teaching activities: Lecturing, assignments, and discussions. Teaching units: Political patterns and parliament, Competition of Parties, Taiwan Economical Miracle, Elders and Their Life, Welfare for Minorities, Education Reformation, Crime and Justice, Cross-affair Relations, Others.

description.zh: 兩性關係是人際關係的核心問題，它關係著交友的態度、婚姻生活的幸福與社會的祥和。本課程由對兩性差異性的了解為基礎，以尊重為原則，在平等互助的精神中，確定兩性關係的和諧。本課程內容包括理論與實際的配合，儘量以生活化的內容貫穿其間，並注重課程內容的可實踐性，以協助學生處理兩性關係的難題。
description.en: Gender Studies is a core issue of interpersonal relationship. It involves attitudes toward making friends, marriage and social tranquility. This course aims to help students become aware of sex difference, understand the importance of respect, equality and mutual-help between sexes. The contents of the course will cover both theory and practice, providing cases and examples related to our daily life so as to help students handle problems when getting along with the opposite sex.

description.zh: 本課程將有系統的介紹西洋各類藝術的來龍去脈，基本知識和理論，解說各時代之繪畫風格，重要畫家，以及著名建築、雕刻、手工藝等，以幻燈教學，使學生瞭解西洋藝術，具備欣賞能力，並能滌淨心靈。課程內容包括: 1.史前藝術：包括洞窟藝術、骨雕石雕等。2.上古藝術：如西亞、埃及、希臘、羅馬、波斯、印度等線畫、雕刻、建築。3.中世紀藝術：拜占廷、東羅馬藝術。4.文藝復興：包涵繪畫、雕刻建築、壁畫等。5.十七、八世紀：巴洛克、洛可可時代。6.近代繪畫：如新古典主義、浪漫派、印象派等。7.現代藝術：野獸派、立體派、超現實主義、象徵主義、抽象派、達達派、普普、歐普、新寫實、未來派、構成派等畫派之繪畫。
description.en: The contents of this course are constructed as following :1.Prehistoric Art : including"The Art of Engraving ", "Carving designs on bone ","Carving designs on stone "..etc. 2.Previous Ancient Art: For instance, the painting engraving architecture of Siya, Egypt, Greece, Rome, Persia, India.etc 3.Art of Middle Ages: Art of Byzantine, Art of Rome. 4.Renaissance: including Painting, Engraving, architecture, fresco etc. 5.Seventeenth and Eighteenth Centuries: Periods of Baroque. Rococo. 6.Modern Painting: for instance, Neoclassicism. Romanticism. Impressionism etc. 7.Contemporary Art: The painting of fauve, Cubism, Surrealism, symbolism, Abstract Art, Dada, Pop Art, Op Art, Neorealism, Futurism, Formalism…etc. The interpretation will include styles of different period, important artists, famous architectures, engraving handicrafts and so on. The Slides will be used as a teaching assistance to help students understand Western Art.

description.zh: 從日語的50音、日常問候用語及自我介紹等開始學起，循序漸進學會日語會話基本語彙、句型及用法等，課程中介紹日本生活習慣、日本文化與年中行事，並採用CD等視聽輔助教材，進行聽力訓練、會話練習及日本歌謠及演歌教唱等。
description.en: This is a beginner's course for Japanese language study. The curriculum structure starts from 50 basic Japanese pronouncing letters. The aims of the courses are to increase students' ability to use the Japanese language for academic, business, and social purposes. In addition, students are introduced to relevant aspects of Japan's life and culture and prepared for work in the specific subject fields.

description.zh: 本課程旨在加強學生閱讀英文報章雜誌的能力與信心，使其運用閱讀技巧，優遊於不同的主題。課程重點如下：(1)提供與時並進的新聞用字，增加學生的語彙能力。(2)分析時事，提高學生的閱讀信心。(3)收聽新聞節目，如ICRT, CNN，增強學生的聽力。
description.en: This course is recommended to students who are interested to develop competence and confidence in reading the newspapers and magazines and applying the reading skills required to all different kinds of topics. The focuses are (1) to introduce key words from up-to-date news which aims at enriching vocabulary power, (2) to analyze the events from news articles to promote confidence in reading, (3) to listen to the live news reports like ICRT, CNN to increase listening ability.

description.zh: 莊子是道家集大成的人物。他的破對待、齊萬物，雖似一異於儒，實則非但與儒相輔相成，且於後來儒說多所啟發。本課程固在使學者能由莊子荒唐之言、無端崖之辭了解莊子，更在使學者能由了解莊子而了解、道會通之處。
description.en: Chuang-tzu is the master figure of Taoism. His awareness of the relativity of all standards and his belief in the equality of all things look different from Confucianism. However, in essence, they are complementary to the understanding of Confucianism, and even inspire some of the later Confucianist ideas. This course intends to focus on Chuang-tzu's absurd remarks and rambling discourses, by which it is hoped that a better understanding of the reciprocity of Taoism and Confucianism can be reached.

description.zh: 介紹台灣地區近五百年以來之開發與變遷，其中歷經西班牙人、荷蘭人、明鄭、滿清以及日本等不同階段之治理，可就政治、經濟、社會、教育及文化等問題分別予以探討，特別是對中華民國政府遷台後之重大建設予以詳細論述，以便對整體台灣歷史之發展得有清晰之認識。
description.en: The course is to introduce the development and evolution of the Taiwan region in the past 500 years. The various stages of the reign by Hollanders, Spaniards, Cheng Ch'eng-kung, Manchurians, and Japanese will be discussed in relation to their politics, economics, social structures, educational systems, and cultural phenomena. The main focus is on the major construction under the reign of the Republic of China.

description.zh: 本課程旨在欣賞篆竟藝術，認識我國歷代著名的篆竟家與優美的作品，由作品之中廣泛瞭解篆竟多樣化的美感表現與技法，並嘗試實現於創作。篆竟是我國特有的一種藝術形式，除了日常日信的實用功能之外，更普遍使用在書法或繪畫等藝術作品中。因此瞭解篆竟藝術之美，往往是面對其他藝術作品時所不可或缺的。篆竟創作必須在方寸微小的天地之內，專注構思，謹慎刻畫。如此苦心經營的體驗，同時也是十分可貴的精神陶冶。
description.en: This course enlightens students on the art, the arlists and the masterworks of seal cutting. Form the appreciation of great works, students sharpen the understanding of the versatile beauty and skills exerted in seal cutting.Seal cutting is a unique form of art in China. It is commonly applied in signets, and extensively connected with calligraphy and painting stampings and other artistic performance. Therefore, the understanding of seal cutting is supposed to be an inevitable way to unveil the curtain of Chinese art palace. Students are expected to work out the composition of seal cutting within centimeters;hence,their concentration and deliberation can be spontaneously molded.

description.zh: 人類為了獲致美好的生活，在物質生活上不斷地努力於自然科學與工藝技術的創造與改進，但在精神的滿足上，雖尚不致於愈來愈貧乏，但如果我們從生活的整體來看，人們似乎並未能真正有效解決他們自己所製造出來的問題。社會科學的研究，即是希望能提供人們對社會及行為科學領域的認識，減少對未來的失望、恐懼；增加對生活的瞭解、憧憬。本課程雖然未能顧及社會及行為的全體，但卻可以讓學習者在最短的時間，掌握到入門的主要課題。
description.en: In order to acquire a better material life, human beings have been working hard on the innovative production and improvement in natural science and technological skills. On the other hand, though people do not suffer from a worse mental satisfaction than before, they have not discovered a way to effectively solve the problems made by themselves, as is viewed from the entire picture of life. The study of social science presents such a good way that the average people would know more about both social and behavioral science, help reduce the fear of future disappointment and, what is important, add to the knowledge and beautiful image of life. This course, though not able to cover all the topics of social and behavioral science, attempts to help students have a good command of major topics in the shortest period of time.

description.zh: (一)認識地球與地球科學 1.認識地球的重要性--經驗的與科學的角度2.地球科學家與地球知識3.地球知識的探究範圍--地球的結構(二)地球與星系的有機係4.宇宙的形成與大爆炸5.地球與銀河系6.地球的動力系統--內動力與外動力(三)岩石圈與人類棲居的範圍7.地球的內動力系統與地殼變動8.岩石圈的形成與特徵:從地質到地形9.岩石圈、陸地與人類活動的關係(四)水圈、大氣圈與自然環境皂動力10.水、空氣與土地的互動11.水循環與外動力系統(陽光)12.大氣運動與天氣變化(五)認識地球的本質13.地球作為人類的家14.節制與維護:人與自煞的和諧交往。
description.en: 1.Knowing the Earth and the science of Earth(1)The importance of knowing earth--its experiential and scientific role(2)Scientists of Earth and the knowlege of earth.(3)The structure of earth.2.The organic relation between earth and galaxy (4)The formation of universe and Big-Bang.(5)The earth and Milky Way Galaxy.(6)The dynamic system of the earth.3.The lithosphere and the horizen of human habitat(7)The inner dynamic system of the earth and the crust change.(8)The formation and characteristic of the lithosphere:from geology to geomorphology.(9)The relation of the lithosphere,continental plate, and human activities.4.The hydrosphere,the atmosphere and the dynamic of the physical environment.(10)The interaction between water, air and land.(11)The hydrologic cycle and the outer dynamic system.(12)The air movement and the weather change.5.Knowing the nature of earth.(13)The earth as a living place for mankind.(14)Restriction and maintance: the harmonious relations between men and nature.

description.zh: 本課程之目標為：充實生活技能、提升科技素養、豐富生活內涵、培養繼續進修之興趣與能力，以奠定終身學習及生涯發展之基礎。本課程之內容為：一、電腦基本概念，二、電腦功能與應用，三、資料處理，四、資訊管理，五、資訊網路，六、電腦的聲光世界，七、電腦的安全問題與防治，八、未來的資訊社會。
description.en: This course is designed to help student to learn another skill, better understand technology, enrich there live and inspire their interests for further study. The course includes: 1.basic knowledge of computer; 2.the application of computer; 3.data procession; 4.data control; 5.internet; 6.multimedia; 7.computer virus; 8. the world of information.

description.zh: 一、教學目標：幫助同學把毛筆字練好，進而培養欣賞能力。二、其教學內容包含1.鑑賞相關知識。2.名碑帖之認識3.篆刻、裱褙 之簡介4.行書、楷書之臨模與創作5.書論之研讀。三、評量則以整學期先後習作之比較出情訂定其成績。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to improve students' ability of appreciating Chinese calligraphy as well as the practice of handwriting skill. The contents include: 1. The knowledge of appreciation 2. Introduction of masterpieces. 3. Introductory studies of seal carving and traditional Chinese picture mounting. 4. Chinese calligraphy practice 5.reference materials study. Grading will be based on the improvement of students` works through all semester.

description.zh: 本課程係為日語入門課程。課程架構由五十音發音的學習開始、定良好的發音基礎。進一步再以句型為骨幹、將日語基本文法融合句型中、並透過日常場面會話的反復問答練習、期望培養會說、會用的簡單會話能力及聽力。予定課程學習目標：名詞、動詞的肯定、否定及時式表現、地點、移動基本句型。
description.en: This is a beginner's lesson for Japanese language study. The curriculum structure starts from 50 basic Japanese pronouncing letters. We wish our students first start with good basic pronunciation, and secondary we will put the basic word pattern as a main framework and combine elementary grammar into the pattern. Then through a repeated practice of daily life conversation, hopefully our students can achieve of using simple Japanese conversation with basic speaking and listen comprehension. Estimated learning targets: Nouns, adjectives, positive and negative of verbs, tense and moving status sentences etc.----basic Japanese word pattern.

description.zh: 台灣經濟的發展已帶動了政治民主化的發展，尤其自解嚴後，政治社會全面變遷，改變幅度之大與範圍之廣，變化之快速與轉變之激烈，予人一種眼花撩亂，目不暇給之感。身為明日舞台的主人，要不被社會拖著走，唯有洞察、掌握社會變遷脈動的能力。本課程將以學術理論為你深入分析、客觀探討。
description.en: The economic development in Taiwan resulted in the rapid development in political spheres. Especially after the lifting of the martial law, the changes in politics and society have exerted a great impact. This course will provide students with the ability to keep track of the changes of the society. Based on political theories, students will learn how to investigate the phenomena and analyze the reasons of these changes.

description.zh: 本課程之設計係針對非歷史系學生研習之用。基本上，以眾所熟知的歷史小說《三國演義》為主軸，來探討中國文化的發展過程中，其在歷史上所扮演角色地位。在文化精神上，它結合了儒、墨、道、法、縱橫家的智慧結晶，開創了新時代的思維視野，對映著儒家文化的另股反思力量，擴展了豐富的文化精神，具有著人生啟示作用。準此，來充實學生文化素養，課程方面包括《三國演義》的文化心理結構，倫理觀，儒、墨、道、法、縱橫家的政治思想，與人物形象之塑造等，藉以幫助學生清晰地認識《三國演義》文化精神在中國文化內涵中之特色。再授課方面，以師生共同討論為主，書面報告為輔，期使學生在短時間內認識《三國演義》的時代精神，並對日後生活有所助益。
description.en: This course is designed for non-history majors. It is chiefly intended to interpret the role and significance of the historical fiction The Romance of the Three kingdoms in the development of the Chinese culture.In the spiritual aspect, The Romance of the Three kingdoms demonstrated the intellectual essence of Confucianism, Mohism,Taoism, the legalist school, and the political strategist school of ancient China. It also innovates new visions and new horizons in the traditional Confucian milieu, thus enriching the spirituality of the Chinese culture. The course includes the following topics of The Romance of the Three kingdoms ：the cultural psychological structure, the ethic view, the political views of Confucianism, Mohism, Taoism, the legalist school, and the political strategist school, the characterization, etc. The class activities include lectures and discussions; students are also expected to submit written reports.

name.en: The Romance of Three Kingdoms and The Chinese Culture

description.zh: 我國文字，兼具形音義之結構，且字字獨立，形體雖有聯繫，而結構自別。以用而言之，或難於規格化，然此正書法之所以能發展為藝術之基本條件也。歷代書寫之體，各因其主觀、客觀之因素而有別，自甲骨而至楷隸，甚至如今日之明體、仿宋等刊刻字形，亦皆有其成因，知書者當能究其竟也。孟子曰：讀其書，不知其人，可乎？「書如其人」，「人書俱老」，誠非虛語。書法者，文章之衣冠，性情之外放。讀其文，觀其書法，不獨知其藝，亦當知其人。
description.en: Chinese characters are unique. Every single character has its own construction as far as word form, phonology and semantics are concerned. All individual character is unique, with different structure in spite of the slight correlation in forms. When it comes to their usage, it is difficult to specify them in a unified manner. But on the other hand, this dissimilitude is what makes calligraphy a type of ART. The TI (literally writing forms) in different ages are different due to the different subjective and objective factors. All of the writing forms of Jia-Gu (literally turtle shells), Kai, Li, and even the modern Ming and Fang-Song (literally simulated Song) have origins of their own, which the educated people are supposed to know something about. Calligraphy to literary works is like the outfit to a person, which exposes the person's inner temperament. By a person's literary work and his calligraphy, we know not only his calligraphic skill, but also his personality.

description.zh: 本課程的主要內容是使學習者：具備科學發展史的基本知識；認識科學研究的方法與態度；知道目前科學理論下的宇宙形成、發展、與未來；認知生命科學和物理科學對人類生活互動關係；具備現代人類所應具備的科學素養。
description.en: This course will have some effects for students that learn the basic knowledge of development historic science, and study the methodology and attitude of science research, know the formation, development, and future of universe in science theories at the present day, cognize the interactions of the life science and physics science to human existence, have got the scientific literacy of the be of modern human.

description.zh: 夏志清教授「中國現代小說史」於張愛玲曾有如下之評：「張愛玲該是中國最優秀、最重要的作家。僅以短篇小說而論，她的成就堪與英美現代女文豪如曼殊菲兒、安泡特等人相比，有些地方她恐怕還要高明一籌。」夏氏之說容或不乏不以為然者，張氏以細膩之心、冷漠之筆，細剖人性陰暗面，所營造出之特殊迷人風貌，則是不爭的事實。本課程以討論方式（選課者須課前細讀指定作品）細部探究作者謀篇佈局之匠心，人物刻劃之功力，除勾勒大家創作之技巧，以為攻錯之石，更期培養與課者閱讀時品察與思辯之能力。
description.en: Erleen Chang, according to the eminent professor of Chinese Modern Novel, C. T.Shia's remarks,"was the most outstanding and influential writer in the history of Chinese Literature. Her accomplishment in short novels could match with that of the American literary giants,Katherine Mansfield and Anna Porter;she even outstripped them in some ways." Although Prof.Shia's favorable comments on Erleen Chang did not produce a unanimousAgreement; however, indubitably, Ms. Chang really excelled in using her exquisite perception and imperturbable depiction to penetrate the darkSide of human beings,which naturally created an enchanting style. InThis class, students' participant discussions are required with a view to making a detailed exploration of Erleen Chang's remarkable skills are expectably developed and improved by way of adequate discussions, andTheir comprehension and appreciation of literary works will by further fostered.

name.en: Selected readings of Erleen Chang's Novels

description.zh: 首先介紹歌劇中音樂的元素、本質及角色，欣賞各時期不同類型之歌劇作品，繼由「世界三大男高音」看歌劇曲目的走向，吸引新生代同學對歌劇之響往，帶領愛樂者進入歌劇欣賞的境界。
description.en: This one-semester course is designed to let students learn: 1.to approach to their first opera with open minds and open ears 2. to understand what opera is. 3. to know the essential elements of opera－composers and librettists, singers, conductors, directors, as well as designs and expenses,...etc.. 4.to understand the development of opera 5.to appreciate opera through watching films of various kind 6.to be able to enjoy opera for the rest of their life.

description.zh: 人的身體一接觸自然界，便開始各個器官的功能，人不如機器，無法汰換零件，加上身體機能遇到問題之後，許多人往往不知如何處理應對，甚至身體出現徵兆也渾然不知。所以此科目最主要的目的是希望藉由對醫學的認識，讓大學生們更瞭解自己的身體，進而保護並時時自我偵測身體是否正常運作，要培養健全的大學生，而不是只會讀書的大病貓。
description.en: Once the human body contacts the natural environment, the organs of the body begin to function. But the human body can not change it's organizational like machine. So when our body's function is in trouble, we always have no idea how to solve it, either to find out. One of these course's objection is to let college students understanding their own body by learning some important medical concepts. We hope that our country both has excellent and healthy college students, and not all sick.

description.zh: 本課程為英文文法觀念的溫故知新，並引導學生將正確的文法觀念運用在閱讀與寫作上，學生可藉由基本句型的練習、句子的改正及句型的修正加強文法
description.en: This course is designated to explain and practice English grammatical structures in relation to reading and writing .A review of grammatical ideas at high level will be reinforced by correcting sentence errors, and revising awkward usage of words or sentence structures. The main subjects include the basic sentence patterns, verbal, conjunctions, and sequences.

description.zh: 本課程旨在欣賞與飲茶活動有關的文學名作，從而瞭解茶歷史與茶文化，認識歷代著名的茶人與茶事。並由欣賞茶以及相關的文物，體會飲茶的藝術與趣味。茶源自我國，然後逐漸成為世界性的飲料。因為飲茶活動富涵藝術與趣味的特質，茶也逐漸成為重要的社交媒介。在我國，茶結合了道家與禪學的思想，其實，茶不僅只是一種美味的飲料，茶道的理念更值得我們悉心探索，藉以浸潤生活的內涵。
description.en: This course aims at first making students acquainted with literature concerning tea by which a better understanding of tea personalities and anecdotes will be obtained and secondly, cultivating students' appreciation of a great variety of tea and cultural artifacts linking with tea by which interests in tea art will be kindled. Having been a luscious beverage brewed for some 3,000 years of Chinese history, tea now has a deep and far-reaching impact on the world. Since making tea illustrates the character of art and affords the delight of life, tea therefore build a bridge among all walks of life. Making tea, combined with Taoist School and Buddhist Meditation, at its uiumate attainment, is both an enjoyment and an artistic summation. The search for tea is a dual process of understanding tea's flavor as well as the thought with it.

description.zh: 『誰掌握了資訊，誰就獲得先機』。二十世紀人類進入資訊時代，資料型態愈趨多元，各類資訊排山倒海而來，人們不再擔心資訊不足，反倒擔憂『資訊氾濫』，多的不得了。在如此多的資訊中，如何去作最有效的選擇與利用，將是知識份子必備的技能。課程內容包括：科學簡介(定義、特興、方法、發展)、科技指標與各類型資料之介紹與利用。
description.en: "Whoever holds the information takes advantage." With an approach to the information age of the 21st century, people are faced with various types of information, which rushes to us like a flood. People are not worried about being lack of information; instead, they are more worried about a "deluge of information." Encountered with so much information, each of the individual intellectuals finds it essential to know how to pick and make use of -with efficiency--the information in need. This type of ability has become a fundamental skill for modern people. The topics covered in this course include: Introduction to Science (Definition, Properties, Approaches and Development), Technological Indexes, and a diverse types of information.

description.zh: 大眾傳播與人類社會的關係，正隨科技的進步而日益擴大它的影響力。根據學者研究發現，人類的思想、態度與價值觀念受大眾傳播的影響日漸加深，大傳媒介不但塑造人的思想，同時也影響人們的行為及價值；然而從傳播的功能言，大眾傳播同時具有正面與負面的社會功能，故大眾傳播的發展與過程，殊值重視與探討。本課程兼顧理論與實例的探討，包括傳播特性與要素、大眾傳播的能及效果、新聞守門人理論等，並以實例分析新聞的公正客觀性、新聞自由與國家安全、媒體與選舉等傳播爭議性問題。修習本課程可培養學生閱讀新聞的正確性，不玫人云亦云，受媒體報導所擺佈；同時亦可增強學生人際溝通的技巧與能力。
description.en: With the advancement of technology, mass communication is enlarging its influence in human society. According to researches, the thoughts, attitudes and value judgements of humans are deeply affected by mass communication. The media not only shape persons' thoughts, but also have an impact on their behavior and values. Since mass communication has positive and negative social functions at the same time, its development and process are therefore worthy of paying much attention and exploration to us. This course includes the study of the theory and practice of mass communication, such as characteristics and elements functions and effects, as well as the theory of the news gatekeepers. It also uses stories to analyze disputed issues, for example, news objectivism, freedom of the press and national security, and media and election. Learning this course, students will be not only capable of cultivating the ability to read a news correctl

description.zh: 本課程將有系統的介紹世界上最新的光電科技發展及在台灣的相關光電產業。時間上規劃以第一小時介紹基本光電理論，第二小時介紹應用技術與實例。課程內容包括：1.雷射光與原理與應用， 2.雷射光與精密量測， 3.雷射光與機械人， 4.光電技術與半導體製造， 5.光資訊與光儲存， 6.光纖通訊系統， 7.紅外系統， 8.紫外線系統， 9. 雷射醫學應用， 10雷射光與國防， 11.光學設計與光學設計軟體， 12 光電科技與未來。
description.en: The course gives the outlook of the technology of Opto-electronics and the industry of Opto-electronics in Taiwan. The contents of this course are constructed as following：1. The principles and applications of Laser, 2. Laser and precise measurements, 3. Laser and robot, 4. Opto-electronics technology and semiconductor magnification, 5. Optical information and Optical storage 6. Optical fiber communication, 7. Infrared system, 8. Ultraviolet system, 9. Medical applications of laser, 10. Laser and defense 11. Optical design and software. 12. Opto-electronics and future.

description.zh: 數學與物理是學習理工科目必備的工具，然而很多同學卻視為畏途。探究其原因，是抽象的思維方式以及部分不合實用的作法，造成學習上的障礙。本課程希望藉由電腦的輔助，將數學、物理與工程數學上幾個重要的觀念具體化，使學生能對抽象觀念有直覺式的體驗，結合理論與實際，進一步提升分析問題的能力。
description.en: Mathematics and Physics are prerequisites for learning science and engineering; nevertheless, many students are afraid to study them. Investigating into the problem, we find that the way of abstract and some impractical methods hinder them from learning those subjects. In this course we will study some major concepts including Mathematics, Physics and Engineering Mathematics etc. and combine the theorems and the realities by the aid of computers to promote our students the capability of analyzing.

description.zh: 本課程係為日語入門課程。課程架構由五十音發音的學習開始、定良好的發音基礎。進一步再以句型為骨幹、將日語基本文法融合句型中、並透過日常場面會話的反復問答練習、期望培養會說、會用的簡單會話能力及聽力。予定課程學習目標：名詞、動詞的肯定、否定及時式表現、地點、移動基本句型。
description.en: This is a beginner's lesson for Japanese language study. The curriculum structure starts from 50 basic Japanese pronouncing letters. We wish our students first start with good basic pronunciation, and secondary we will put the basic word pattern as a main framework and combine elementary grammar into the pattern. Then through a repeated practice of daily life conversation, hopefully our students can achieve of using simple Japanese conversation with basic speaking and listen comprehension. Estimated learning targets: Nouns, adjectives, positive and negative of verbs, tense and moving status sentences etc.----basic Japanese word pattern.

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

description.zh: 介紹日常生活中所經常遭遇到的案例使學生認識法律上之常識，培養學生珍惜法律上所賦予之權利，並及時行使庶免讓權利睡著了，致蒙受意外損害。並督促學生善盡法律上之責任，蔚為人人知法，人人守法的風尚，導致社會祥和。授課內容：按民法總則、債篇、物權、親屬、繼承各篇之順序，選擇與日常生活關係最密切之案例，逐一介紹，並對解決之道詳加說明。有觸及民間權益者，例如民間互助會，使用票據之常識，海峽兩岸婚姻，汽車肇事與保險責任及軍人及其家屬優待條例等均一併介紹。
description.en: This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

description.zh: 本課程將使學生學習到氣象的一些基本知識，並應用於日常生活中。內容包括太空中的地球、天氣的要素、鋒面與風暴、世界的氣候、氣候變遷、天氣的觀測與分析、天氣預報、雲的種類、天象導覽、天氣觀察者指南等。
description.en: This course will let students learn the basic knowledge of the weather and use it to their life. The content includes the earth in the space, elements of the weather, fronts and storms, climate of the world, climate change, observing and analyzing the weather, types of clouds, field guide to the sky, weather watcher's resource guide.

description.zh: 西藥及中草藥是中華民族的傳統藥，也是中國藥學寶庫的重組成成分，中草藥包括中藥、草藥（即民間藥）以及少數民族地區使用的民族藥，在中國，使用中草藥防病治病已有數千年之歷史，寶鑑證明，中草藥療效確切，副作用較合成中藥少，力來深受群眾喜愛。當前，人類健康需要傳統醫藥之觀點正為越來越多之國家和人民接受，開發傳統要已成為當今藥物發展的潮流。同時，近年來科學研究成果表明，從中草藥發展出療效好，毒性低的新藥是一條成功的捷徑。因此，學習中草藥之人員日漸增加。本課程共分：西藥概論、中草藥概論、內科中草藥、兒科中草藥、男科中草藥、婦科中草藥、美容養生中草藥等。
description.en: The Drugs on Life is a two credit hours course and design especially for technology students. This curriculum emphasizes on the clinical applications and action mechanisms of various western and Chinese drugs. The curriculum trends will start from more details and bring a completely concepts. The subjects include neuropharmacology, autacoids, cardiovascular drugs, analgesics, anaethesia and drugs actiong on the central nervous system, chemotherapy of microbial disease and neoplastic disease, hormones and hormone antagonists, drugs acting on the blood and some Chinese drugs.

description.zh: 本課程是為非專業學生所設計的哲學概論，介紹西洋哲學的起源、西洋哲學的問題，以及哲學與人生的關係。哲學的問題意識起自人類的自覺，人類意圖認識自己，為宇宙人生尋求解答，哲學的發生本自人類天賦的求知欲，即其本性中對於智慧的追求與愛慕。這種愛慕智慧的精神是希臘文明留給西方世界的遺產，對於知識能持客觀批判的精神，對於真理能存認真熱切的態度，對於人生能有超克苦難的修持。在國際化的世代，我們對西方的認識應更深入其精神層面，此乃本課程規劃的初衷。
description.en: This course is designed for student who is not disciplined in philosophy. As an introduction, we begin at the origin of western philosophy, the philosophical questions and finally, the relationship of human life and philosophy. Philosophy takes place when human being thinking of himself. Man by nature desire to know himself as well as the external world. And due to this love of wisdom, men can be critical to knowledge and be passionate toward truth. Eventually, grasping the sprit of western philosophy , we can view our life in quite a different view. In our time, facing the world of international, we should better understand the western culture, which is rooted in philosophy.

description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders. Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely. The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing. On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized. Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth. The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

description.zh: 派系是人類社群普遍存在的小團體現象，更是我國社會轉型中的重要政治現象之一。派系內部、派系與派系間、派系與國家機關間的互動結果，對台灣的政治發展與變遷，具有重大的影響。 本課程期能提供學習者關心社會政治的議題，認識自己所處的政治社會的生態環境並增進政治抉擇的能力，以建構民主法治所需的公民社會基礎。 探討內容包括派系的概念、形成的原因與特質；派系結構變動的理論；我國政治轉型中派系的角色、功能與消長；派系政治對台灣政治民主化的影響等。
description.en: Factions, a small-group phenomenon existing widely in human society, have been an important political phenomenon in the transforming of our society. Interactions within factions, among factions, and between factions and state organizations-these have made great impact on Taiwan's political development and changes. This course serves several purposes: providing socio-political issues that are of relevance and interest to students; facilitating students becoming more aware of the ecological environment of the political and social systems involving them; developing their ability to make appropriate decisions about which political party to support or vote for. Moreover, the instructor hopes that this course will have a share in contributing to the establishment of a citizen-society foundation essential for the construction of democracy and rule of law.

name.en: Factors and Political Changes in Taiwan

description.zh: 提供本校四技學生在本行以外，對其他領域的認識，以彌補其只鑽研專業課程的偏頗，訓練學生整合知識，使不致在知識爆炸的時代中迷失，促進各種專材的溝通，培養共識；培育人文素養，啟發人文關懷，使具有完整的人生觀。
description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 本科目屬通識教育之課程範圍，係以系統（System Theory）理論的觀點，針對「開放社會」中的教育問題加以探討。其分析的層面概分為兩大類群，一為鉅視觀點，即從各種社會制度與政策，諸如經濟、政治、階層、資訊、宗教等各方面，分析對於教育的影響與互動關係；另一為微視觀點，即從社會整體對教育各層面，諸如教育目標、學校型態、教師角色、學生學習、家長參與等各議題加以分析其影響性。本課程之預期目標為，透過本課程的安排，得以明析當代開放社會與教育之間，互為變遷動因與條件的實態，進而產生進一步探究的興趣。
description.en: This subject, one of the courses of General Education, aims to analyze the educational issues of an "Open Society" from System Theory perspective. The analysis can be carried out in two ways：first, from macro-viewpoint, it means to study the influences and interrelation that different social institution and policies such as economy, politics, stratification, information, religion, etc. have exerted on education. second, from micro-viewpoint, it analyzes the influences of the whole society on every aspects of education such as education objective, school style, role of teachers, learning of students, participation of parents, etc.Through the programme of this course, we hope to illustrate the fact that the contemporary open society and education are reciprocal factors and conditions of changes.

description.zh: 本課程將結合邏輯基礎課程與科學典範理論，說明邏輯與科學的關係。邏輯教人如何正確地思想才不致錯誤，邏輯也指示研究科學的方法，因為科學的理論與實驗的體系都必須通過邏輯推論。科學革命是科學典範的轉移，這代表新觀念介入，產生新的邏輯系統，這代表觀察世界的角度有所更新。科學是一種系統性的知識，邏輯提供科學形式的建構，科學典範理論則提供科學內容的取捨標準。本課程期許科學研究者從一種超越的角度，理解科學的基礎、科學的價值，與科學的限制。
description.en: This course combines the elementary Logic and the paradigm theory of science. The reason of this combination is to explain the very relation of Logic and science. Logic is aimed at thinking correctly and avoiding mistakes. It governs science in respect that scientific theories should be reasoning through Logic. The revolution of science is the transformation of scientific paradigm. And it is some fresh insight that concerns about the worldview interfered the logical system of the original theory. The core of this course is to investigate the construction of scientific theory; it's base and method. Students are expected to be skilled at logical reasoning and understand the nature of science as well.

description.zh: 婚姻是一般人所必經的過程，家庭是生活的場所，關係著人生的幸福與美滿。本課程強調美滿婚姻與幸福家庭是一門學問，因此，課程內容包括：對婚姻與家庭有正確的認知、積極的態度、完整的規劃，並培養有認真努力去實踐的方法與能力。如何追求真正的快樂與幸福？除了在婚姻與家庭中追求平等化、合理化、自由化、公平化外，自我成長、相互尊重都是本課程的學習目標，以協助學生思考婚姻與家庭的終生大事。

The contents of this course include having the correct understanding of marriage and family, cultivating positive attitude, developing complete plans, and realizing them with all efforts. This course will help students think totally about marriage and family, learn to pursue equality, reasonableness and liberty, keep growing and respect each other, so that we can obtain the real delight and happiness.

description.zh: 本課程為建築史研究及寫作的入門課程，內容主要是介紹與歷史研究有關的各種理論與方法，及其運用於建築方面的狀況，目的為訓練研習者建立個人的歷史敘事觀，與從事建築歷史寫作的能力。課程含三大部份：1.「歷史」意義概說。2.歷史研究理論與方法研討。3.建築史名作敘事架構分析。
description.en: This course is an introduction to the historical study and academic writing on architecture. The main body relates to theories and methods concerning with historical study and the possible application in architecture. It aims at the establishment of a analytical vision and the ability in academic writing in doing research of architectural history. Three parts are concluded:1. Defining the meaning of 'History'.2. Exploring the theories of historical studies and research methodologies.3. Analyzing the structure of remarkable articles on 'architecture history'.

description.zh: 主要在電腦相關應用方面的加強，當作設計工具、研究主題應用和電腦圖形方法研究及開發在都市和建築等領域方面程式發展以解決研究領域之問題.
description.en: Emphasis on application of the computer as a design tool, topical applications and computer graphic methods, development of computer software for architectural and urban problem solving.

name.zh: 電腦在都市建築之應用

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。二技三年級實施普通班體育正課教學。
description.en: The teaching goal is to establishing students have a Health life、Sportsmanship、Team work and Life time exercise habit. All Freshman students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. For Freshman level, Classes focus on basic physical strength training.

description.zh: 本課程從化學的觀點來談論氣相分子與固體表面之交互作用與變化；包括表面結構、吸附/脫附、分子和表面間之鍵結、反應動力學等。主要的表面分析儀器包括；X光電子光譜儀(XPS)、歐傑電子光譜儀（AES）、低能電子繞射儀(LEED)、電子穿隧掃描儀(STM)、表面振動光譜儀(vibrational spectroscopy)，及真空技術也將做概述性介紹。
description.en: The purpose of this course is, from chemistry point of view, to discuss the interaction of gas phase molecules with solid surfaces. This includes surface structures, adsorption/desorption, surface bonding and reaction. The following surface analytical techniques: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), Auger electron spectroscopy (AES), Low energy electron diffraction spectroscopy (LEED), scanning tunneling microscopy (STM), surface vibrational spectroscopy, and vacuum technology will also be included.

description.zh: 染料發色理論，染料類別與性質，染料中間體，偶氮染料之製備以及分散、反應、直接等染料之結構與性質之介紹與說明。
description.en: It covers the chromophores, Colour Index intermediates and properties of different kinds of dyes. The details of preparation of azo dyes,disperse dyes and reactive dyes are also described.

description.zh: 本課程主要目標包括以下各方面：1.介紹與瞭解電腦繪圖在環境規劃設計上的應用方法與理論。2.學會建築設計作品的首頁建構與網路基本應用的操作。3.學習建築設計影像處理技術。授課內容主題包括：電腦輔助建築繪圖與網路應用表現，個人Homepage設計，設計作品網頁表現，建築專業影像處理與環境影像改造，平面動態影像處理技術，建築專業輔助繪圖設計軟體的介紹應用。

We learn how to create homepage of architectural design in www.3. We learn the image process analysis in architectural environment.The contents of this class is included about: the presentation of computer-aided architectural design and application in www, personal homepage design and personal design work's presentation, professional image process analysis in architectural environment, animation of 2D image process and application, introduction and application of professional soft of computer-a

name.en: Special Issues of Computer-Aided Architectural Design (I)

description.zh: 本課程授課主要分成六項：（1）從都市歷史發展，討論過去、現在與未來；（2）以永續都市發展理論，探討都市型態及設計理論；（3）以都市空間的構成探討解讀、架構及產生的理論；（4）以都市空間的形成探討社會過程、技術過程及創造過程：（5）以都市實質設計的涵構探討都市的實質、自然及人文設計，並藉以討論土地使用、開放空間、建築形式與量體、流通動線、停車場、街道家具及支持活動等；（6）以都市設計的技術探討主要計畫、細部計畫、都市計畫通盤檢討、都市更新、土地使用分區管制及都市景觀管制等技術性課題
description.en: The subject is hereby divided into six parts (1) discussing the past, present and future from standpoint of the chronicle of urban development; (2) exploring the urban pattern and design theory be referring to on-going urban development; (3) inquiring into the theory of formation, configuration and generation and urban space; (4) searching the social process, technical process and creation process through the formation of urban space; (5) from the virtual, natural and cultural design to review the proper layout of land use, open space, building pattern and volume, flow dynamic line, parking lot, road, furniture and support for citizen activity; (6) technically reviewing the main urban plan, detail plan, overall review of urban plan, urban renewal, land use, zone control and urban landscape.

description.zh: 1.建築法規體系概述、2.中央法規標準法、3.建築法架構解說、4.建築師法及營造業管理規則、5.省市建築管理規則、6.省市畸零地使用規則、7.面臨現有巷道申請建築原則、8.都市計劃法系簡介及鄉關法規介紹、9.建築技術規則及台北市土地使用分區管制規則、10. 研定(修)中之建築法規介紹。

description.zh: 先修課程:負責教授同意半導體元件、整流電路，電晶體和電路，運算放大器、線性積體電路，邏輯元件，數位電路，數位積體電路，微處理器，放大器等。
description.en: Semiconductor Device, Rectifier circuit, Transistor Circuit, Operational Amplifier, Linear Integrated Circuit, Logic Device, Digital Circuit, Digital Integrated Circuit, Micro Processor, Amplifier, etc..

description.zh: 1. 瞭解電路元件之基本特性及其組合電路之分析方法，內容包含： (1)電路元件：電壓及電流源，主動元件， (2)電路特性：歐姆定律，柯希荷夫電壓與電流定律等， (3)一階及二階電路：電路之微分方程描述及各種輸入信號之響應， (4)穩態分析與頻率響應：分析電路之頻域， (5)電腦輔助電路分析：如使用 SPICE 工具。 2. 瞭解線性與非線性電路的組成與分析法，內容包含： (1)交流激勵電路：交流穩態分析，功率計算及相電路， (2)三相電路：Ｙ與△型轉換及功率分析， (3)變壓器電路：互感應及電壓電流的變換， (4)頻率響應分析：極點與零點，轉移函數， (5)Fourier 級數，轉換及應用， (6)Laplace轉換及應用。
description.en: The course covers the synthesis and analysis of bath linear and nonlinear circuits.Contents include: 1.Introduction to linear circuit analysis, 2. Resistive circuit, 3. Kirchhoff laws, 4. Thevenin and Norton theorem, 5. First and second order circuit, 6. Node and loop analysis, 7. Steady state response and analysis, 8. SPICE tool, 9.AC circuit :AC steady-state analysis, phasor analysis, 10. Three phase circuits, 11. Transformer circuits, 12. Frequency response, 13. Fourier series, Fourier transformation and application, 14. Laplace transformation and application.

description.zh: 課程包含下列主題：(1)知識經濟導論(2)知識產業分析(3)知識經濟發展模式(4)知識管理VS.知識經濟(5)知識成本評估模式(6)知識經濟管理參考模式
description.en: This course includes following topics: (1) the introduction of Knowledge economics, (2) the analysis of knowledge industry, (3) the development model for knowledge economics, (4) knowledge management vs. knowledge economics, (5) Intellectual cost evaluation model, (6) knowledge economics reference model.

description.zh: 全適性設計專題在探討多元化使用族群適用的產品、環境、和溝通，以尊重人性福址為前提之設計創新思維，開啟新產品開發策略做法，滿足各種各樣的使用者需求。從相關的理論和案例研討，到專題設計的研發，體認詮釋性設計思維方法與實務。
description.en: It is a worldwide design movement that wants to make products, environments and communication usable to the greatest extent possible by the broadest number of users including children, older adults, people with disabilities, people of atypical size or shape, people who are ill of injured, and people inconvenienced by circumstances. Universal design respects human diversity and promotes inclusion of all people in all activities of life. It is not an identifiable style but a way of thinking about the design process. Universal design defines good design as attractive and user-friendly.

name.zh: 電腦教學理論與研究發展

description.zh: 資訊管理是一門較新的管理學門，在電腦早期發展時期，只有專業電腦人員才會懂得如何操作電腦，但隨著資訊科技的進步，個人電腦的普及，一般非資訊人員也可以很容易操作與使用電腦。然而會用電腦不見的對企業有所幫助，思考資訊科技如何給企業帶來競爭優勢是資訊管理領域所考慮的重要議題。一般來說，資訊管理主要探討企業如何對資訊系統及資訊人員作最有效的管理，以其與企業目標結合，替企業增加競爭優勢。本課程即站在管理與策略的角度分析企業應如何對資訊資源（包括資料、資訊系統與資訊人員）做最有效的管理，上課方式將採用個案研討為主，以期學生能瞭解理論與實務的發展。
description.en: This course will discuss how the organizations gain their competitive advantage through Information Technology. It covers the following three major parts: Part 1:Information System Planning. Part 2: Information System Management in the Organization. Part 3: Strategic use of Information System Part 4:Electronic Commerce and strategic impact.

description.zh: 現今全球正處於電腦e世代時候，文字、影像、聲音、影片被廣泛的運用來傳送信息及資訊流通上。而如何來組織這些文字、影像、聲音、影片等資料就顯的非常必須且重要了。本課程將指導學生如何掌握現今市面上之電腦多媒體應用工具並將以應用在建築領域上。（上學期）
description.en: Text,image,audio,video are common used to transmit information now.How to organize and repreaent these different kind of data becames an important issue.This course will help you to master some computer multimedia tools in architecture filed.

description.zh: 針對企業管理不同的對象，如經營策略、經營文化、事務管理、預算管理等，以實際個案方式介紹並討論。
description.en: This class will introduce and discuss the application on the following topics: Business strategies, business culture, factory management, and budgeting management.

description.zh: 為使都市安全防災的理論與實務能相互結合，特別以921震災後之重建為主題，作為實務訓練，所以本課程授課主要內容分為三部分：第一部份為都市防災概論，此部分主要針對國內外文獻作一回顧，進而瞭解都市防災整體架構，區分為（1）文獻回顧；（2）防災基本計畫；及（3）防災整體架構等。第二部份為都市與都市計畫防災，此部分從防災理論著手，逐漸導入都市計畫防災實務，最後提出防災都市計畫作業的方式與內容，期使國內都市計畫能逐步邁向防災都市計畫，以建立『安全都市』為目標。此部分的主要內容區分為：（1）都市災害風險理念的形成；（2）防災都市計畫與地區防災系統規劃；（3）都市計畫防災系統規劃原則；（4）都市計畫防災作業準則內容架構；（5）都市計畫防災作業準則；（6）安心都市計畫的形成與實現。第三部分為實務操作部分，以草屯鎮為例，藉九二一大地震的實例，深入探討災情調查的方法，實際調查狀況及研訂災後重建的程序與計畫內容，期望成為國內都市重建計畫的範例，主要內容區分為：（1）緒論；（2）重建理論；（3）草屯鎮現況發展；（4）災情調查方法與重建程序之建立；（5）災情調查分析與重建計畫內容研訂等。
description.en: The subject will be presented in three partsPart One - (1) Literature retrospection; (2) Fundamental planning for disaster prevention; (3) An integrated disaster prevention organization.Part Two -The major contents to be addressed include (1) Formation of urban disaster cataclysm and risk; (2) Urban disaster prevention plan and regional disaster protection system planning; (3) Principles for planning disaster prevention system in urban plan; (4) Operational standards and organization for urban disaster prevention; (5) Operational guidelines for urban disaster prevention; (6) Realization and formation of trouble free urban plan.Party Three -. The major contents are (1) Introduction; (2) rehabilitation theory; (3) Current development in Tsaotun City; (4) Establishment of damage survey method and rehabilitation procedures; (5) Detail analysis of damage survey report and preparation of rehabilitation plan content

description.zh: 本課程內容包括通風系統基礎，工業通風，排煙設計，空氣過濾、送風系統設計及安裝與測試，以系統設計為重點。
description.en: The contents of this course include the fundamentals of ventilation system, industrial ventilation, exhaust design, air filtration, air moving system design, construction and testing, the focus of this course is on the system design.
